stem.text: The graph shows the oxygen dissociation curves of haemoglobin for eight species of mammal.

stem.alt: Graph of percentage oxygen saturation of haemoglobin against partial pressure of oxygen in kPa, with eight curves numbered 1 to 8.

stem.text: mammals in decreasing order of size
Which conclusion is consistent with the data shown in the graph?

A.text: The haemoglobin of larger mammals will combine with oxygen at a lower partial pressure of oxygen than that of smaller mammals.

B.text: The haemoglobin of larger mammals will release oxygen at a higher partial pressure of oxygen than that of smaller mammals.

C.text: The metabolic activity of the mammal is directly proportional to the ability of its haemoglobin to release oxygen.

D.text: The size of the mammal is directly proportional to the ability of its haemoglobin to release oxygen.
